items.t: Copper’s partial rebound: physical tightness vs. bearish sentiment
items.sum: Investing.com -- Copper (HG) was at $5.6505 per lb, down 0.32%, as of Nov 19, 7:53 AM EST. The 6% drop on Nov 18 has only been partly retraced. The Comex price is barely above that session’s low, and the rebound is thin. On the LME, three-month copper was reported back above $12,500 a ton, about 16% below the September record of $14,875.
